correctness.rationale: Each spoke pair cu,cv sharing center can only be locally edge-resolved by u or v: every other vertex, including center, has the same distance to the two spokes. Therefore every generator contains at least rm-1 noncentral vertices. Conversely S equal to all noncentral vertices except w distinguishes adjacent e=pq,f=pr by a selected noncommon endpoint; the unique configuration with omitted w and center as noncommon endpoints is resolved by any selected vertex in another blade, giving edge-distances 2 and 1. Equality in lower bound rules out center and fixes all minimum sets. Independent all-subset BFS enumeration for W_(2,2), W_(2,3), W_(3,2) agrees; finite checks are supplementary.
